note: Ps75 God the Judge (corrected). Human IB: the GIVE-THANKS (yadah x2) + RECOUNT of God's deeds; the BOASTFUL (halal) + WICKED + HAUGHTY (athak) warned 'do not BOAST, do not LIFT UP (rum) your horn'; the resolve to DECLARE + SING-PRAISES forever; the RIGHTEOUS (whose horn God lifts). God-qualifiers=11 (name/near/wondrous-deeds; judge/equity/keep-steady/judgment/put-down/lift-up-another/cut-off/lift-up-the-righteous). Horn imagery + cup-of-foaming-wine wrath + directions = standalone. Every candidate roled.

dims.v: give thanks / praise (yadah - we give thanks to you)
to God, whose name is near
paired with the doubled thanks and the recounting

'We GIVE THANKS (yadah) to you, O God; we give thanks, for your name is near' — the doubled thanksgiving that opens the psalm; yadah here the grateful worship of the community, moved by God's nearness (the qualifier) and his wondrous deeds
give thanks / praise (yadah - we give thanks, doubled)
the emphatic doubling of the thanksgiving
'we GIVE THANKS (yadah)' — the second of the doubled thanks; yadah repeated for emphasis, the fullness of the community's gratitude to the near God
recount / tell (saphar - we recount your wondrous deeds)

'We RECOUNT (saphar) your wondrous deeds' — the telling of God's works that accompanies the thanks; saphar here the recital of God's wonders (the qualifier), gratitude expressed as testimony to what God has done
boastful / arrogant (halal - I say to the boastful)
paired with the wicked warned not to lift the horn

'I say to the BOASTFUL (halal), Do not boast' — the arrogant God directly warns; halal here the self-glorying (the same root as praise, turned to self-praise) - the boasters whom God, the true exalter, admonishes to stop
the boasting the boastful are told to cease

'Do not BOAST (halal)' — the self-exaltation God forbids; halal here the act of boasting the arrogant must stop, since exaltation comes from God alone (v6-7) - the vanity of self-glory before the Judge
wicked (rasha - to the wicked, do not lift up your horn)
warned not to lift up the horn
paired with the boastful; their horns God will cut off (v10)

'and to the WICKED (rasha), Do not lift up your horn' — the godless warned against arrogant strength; rasha here the wicked whose lifted horn (self-exalting power) God will cut off (v10) - warned by the very Judge who will humble them
lift up / exalt (rum - do not lift up your horn)
paired with speaking with haughty neck (v5)

'Do not LIFT UP (rum) your horn; do not lift up your horn on high' — the arrogant self-exaltation God forbids; rum here the raising of the horn, the gesture of proud, defiant strength - self-promotion the wicked must abandon, for lifting up is God's to give (v7)
haughty / arrogant (athak - speak with haughty neck)
paired with lifting up the horn

'or speak with HAUGHTY (athak) neck' — insolent, defiant speech; athak here the arrogance of the stiff-necked, speaking boldly against God - the outward voice of the lifted horn, pride made audible, which the Judge silences
declare / proclaim (nagad - I will declare it forever)
paired with singing praises to the God of Jacob
of the God who executes judgment, putting down and lifting up (v7)

'But I will DECLARE (nagad) it forever; I will sing praises to the God of Jacob' — the psalmist's answering witness to God the Judge; nagad here the proclaiming of God's just rule (the qualifiers judge/put-down/lift-up) - not silence but continual testimony that God alone exalts and humbles
sing praises (zamar - I will sing praises to the God of Jacob)

'I will SING PRAISES (zamar) to the God of Jacob' — the worship that answers God's just judgment; zamar here the song of the one who trusts the Judge - praise where the wicked drink the cup of wrath, the believer sings
righteous (tsaddiq - the horns of the righteous shall be lifted up)
horns lifted up, opposite the wicked's cut off
set against the wicked whose horns are cut off

'but the horns of the RIGHTEOUS (tsaddiq) shall be lifted up' — the exaltation God grants the upright; tsaddiq here the righteous whose horn (strength/dignity) God raises, over against the wicked whose horns he cuts off - the true lifting-up that comes from the Judge, not from self-boasting (the exalting being the qualifier, 282710)
God's name near, ground of the thanksgiving (v1)
v1 QUALIFIER (God's name): 'for your NAME (shem) is near' - God's name is not a human IB char; the nearness of God's name that draws forth the thanksgiving (282696). Qualifier.
God's nearness, ground of the thanksgiving (v1)
v1 QUALIFIER (God's nearness): 'for your name is NEAR (qarob)' - God's nearness is not a human IB char; the closeness that grounds the community's thanks (282696). Qualifier.
wondrous deeds (pala - we recount your wondrous deeds)
God's wondrous deeds, which the worshippers recount (v1)
v1 QUALIFIER (God's deeds): 'we recount your WONDROUS DEEDS (pala)' - God's wonders are not a human IB char; the works the community recounts (282701). Qualifier.
judge (shaphat - I will judge with equity)
God judges with equity, which the psalmist declares (v2->v9)

v2 QUALIFIER (God's act): 'At the set time that I appoint I will JUDGE (shaphat) with equity' - God's judging is not a human IB char; his righteous judgment the psalmist declares forever (282765). Qualifier.
equity / uprightness (meshar - I will judge with equity)
God's equity in judging, which the psalmist declares (v2->v9)
v2 QUALIFIER (God's equity): 'I will judge with EQUITY (meshar)' - God's fairness is not a human IB char; the uprightness of his judgment the psalmist proclaims (282765). Qualifier.
keep steady / establish (takan - I keep steady its pillars)
God keeps steady the earth's pillars, which the psalmist declares (v3->v9)

v3 QUALIFIER (God's act): 'When the earth totters... it is I who KEEP STEADY (takan) its pillars' - God's upholding of the tottering earth is not a human IB char; his sustaining power the psalmist declares (282765). Qualifier.
judge / execute judgment (shaphat - it is God who executes judgment)
God executes judgment, which the psalmist declares (v7->v9)

v7 QUALIFIER (God's act): 'but it is God who executes JUDGMENT (shaphat)' - God's judging is not a human IB char; the divine prerogative the psalmist declares (282765) - exaltation comes not from any direction but from the Judge. Qualifier.
put down / humble (shaphel - putting down one)
God puts down one, which the psalmist declares (v7->v9)
v7 QUALIFIER (God's act): 'PUTTING DOWN (shaphel) one and lifting up another' - God's humbling is not a human IB char; his sovereign lowering of the proud the psalmist declares (282765). Qualifier.
lift up / exalt (rum - lifting up another)
God lifts up another, which the psalmist declares (v7->v9)

v7 QUALIFIER (God's act, re-roled from an earlier mis-call): 'putting down one and LIFTING UP (rum) another' - God's exalting is not a human IB char; the true lifting-up that is God's alone to give (contrast the wicked's self-exalting, v4), declared by the psalmist (282765). Qualifier.
cut off (gada - all the horns of the wicked I will cut off)
God cuts off the horns of the wicked, which the psalmist declares (v10->v9)

v10 QUALIFIER (God's act): 'All the horns of the wicked I will CUT OFF (gada)' - God's severing of the wicked's power is not a human IB char; the judgment on the proud the psalmist declares (282765). Qualifier.
lift up / exalt (rum - the horns of the righteous shall be lifted up)
God lifts up the horns of the righteous (v10)

v10 QUALIFIER (God's act, re-roled from an earlier mis-call): 'but the horns of the righteous shall be LIFTED UP (rum)' - God's exalting of the righteous is not a human IB char; the true exaltation he grants the upright (282709), opposite the wicked's cut-off horns. Qualifier.
appointed time (moed - the set time that I appoint)
v2: 'At the SET TIME (moed) that I appoint I will judge with equity' - the appointed moment of God's judgment; the fixed time of his reckoning. Standalone (the appointed time).
totter / melt (mug - when the earth totters)

v3: 'When the earth TOTTERS (mug), and all its inhabitants' - the shaking of the earth God holds steady; the image of cosmic instability God alone stabilizes (the qualifier keep-steady, 306719). Standalone (image).
v3: 'it is I who keep steady its PILLARS (ammud)' - the pillars of the earth God upholds; the image of the world's foundations. Standalone (image).
horn (qeren - do not lift up your horn)
v4: 'Do not lift up your HORN (qeren)' - the horn as symbol of strength/pride; the object of the wicked's self-exaltation (the char lift-up, 282722). Standalone (image of strength/pride).
lift up (rum - do not lift up your horn on high)
v5: 'do not LIFT UP (rum) your horn on high' - the emphatic repeat of the warning (the char lift-up, 282722); the proud raising of the horn, restated. Standalone (repeat).
v5: 'do not lift up your HORN (qeren) on high' - the horn of the wicked's pride, repeated; the symbol of defiant strength. Standalone (image).
on high / height (marom - your horn on high)
v5: 'lift up your horn ON HIGH (marom)' - the height to which the wicked raise their horn; the loftiness of their pride. Standalone (the height of pride).
v5: 'or speak with haughty NECK (tsavvar)' - the stiff, outstretched neck of arrogance; the bodily image of the haughtiness (the char, 282729). Standalone (image of pride).
east / going forth (motsa - not from the east)
v6: 'For not from the EAST (motsa) or from the west' - the directions from which exaltation does not come; the point that lifting-up is not earthly but from God (v7). Standalone (direction).
west / going down (maarab - from the west)
v6: 'or from the WEST (maarab) and not from the wilderness' - the directions from which promotion does not come; exaltation is God's, not from any earthly quarter. Standalone (direction).
lift up / exaltation (rum - comes lifting up)

v6: 'not from the wilderness comes LIFTING UP (rum)' - the exaltation that comes from no earthly direction but from God the Judge (v7); the true promotion, God's to give. Standalone (the exaltation from God).
cup (kos - a cup with foaming wine)
v8: 'in the hand of the LORD there is a CUP (kos)' - the cup of God's wrath; the image of judgment the wicked must drink. Standalone (image of wrath).
v8: 'a cup with FOAMING (chamar) wine' - the seething, red wine of wrath in the cup; the image of God's fermenting judgment. Standalone (image).
v8: 'a cup with foaming WINE (yayin)' - the wine of wrath, image of the intoxicating judgment the wicked drink. Standalone (image).
v8: 'WELL (male) mixed' - the cup full of mixed wine; the potency of the wrath prepared for the wicked. Standalone (image).
v8: 'well MIXED (mesek)' - the spiced/mixed wine of the wrath-cup; the strong draught of judgment. Standalone (image).
pour out (nagar - he pours out from it)
v8: 'and he POURS OUT (nagar) from it' - God pouring the cup of wrath; the dispensing of judgment on the wicked. Standalone (the pouring of wrath).
wicked (rasha - all the wicked of the earth shall drain it)

v8: 'all the WICKED (rasha) of the earth shall drain it down to the dregs' - the wicked (the char, 282720) who must drink the cup of wrath to the last drop; their doom. Standalone (the wicked drinking the cup).
v8: 'shall DRAIN (matsa) it down to the dregs' - the wicked draining the wrath-cup completely; the totality of their judgment. Standalone (image).
v8: 'shall drain it DOWN (shatah) to the dregs' - the drinking of the cup to the bottom; the wicked's forced draught of wrath. Standalone (image).
dregs / lees (shemer - down to the dregs)
v8: 'drain it down to the DREGS (shemer)' - the bitter sediment at the bottom of the wrath-cup; the last, worst measure of judgment the wicked must swallow. Standalone (image).
forever (olam - I will declare it forever)
v9: 'But I will declare it FOREVER (olam)' - the perpetuity of the psalmist's declaring (the char, 282765); the everlasting extent of his testimony. Standalone (temporal).
horns (qeren - all the horns of the wicked)

v10: 'All the HORNS (qeren) of the wicked I will cut off' - the horns (strength/pride) of the wicked God will sever; the object of his cutting-off (the qualifier, 282707). Standalone (image of the wicked's power).
wicked (rasha - the horns of the wicked)
v10: 'the horns of the WICKED (rasha) I will cut off' - the wicked (the char, 282720) whose power God will sever; the proud humbled. Standalone (the wicked judged).
horns (qeren - the horns of the righteous)

v10: 'but the HORNS (qeren) of the righteous shall be lifted up' - the horns (strength/dignity) of the righteous God raises; the object of his exalting (the char righteous, 282709). Standalone (image of the righteous' dignity).
